usedFor: Upvoted collects feature requests, and Microsoft Excel lists each through “Add Row To Table” on “new feature is added”.

bestTemplate.name: “new feature is added” in Upvoted, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Every new request becomes a row, so product can rank and filter ideas in a table.

watchOut: “new feature is added” is polling, so a request appears in Excel after the next scheduled check.
